task: Payment receipts show yen wrong (the yen receipt test fails). Fix it.

results.final_message:
I fixed the yen receipt bug, and the full test suite now passes (18 of 18).

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, which is right for pounds, dollars and euros but wrong for yen, which has no minor unit. A 500 yen payment came out as `¥5.00` instead of `¥500`.

I added a small zero-decimal currency list containing `JPY`. Those currencies now print the amount as it is, with no division and no decimals.

`formatMoney` is shared by invoices, payments, cart and admin, so any of those that show yen will now print whole yen as well. I only searched for yen in the code and tests, and the receipt test is the only place it came up.

Yen receipts now show correctly, and the yen receipt test passes along with the other 17 tests.

`formatMoney` is shared, so cart totals and invoice lines also show yen correctly now. No other tests use yen, so nothing else changed. If you support other zero-decimal currencies such as KRW, add them to that set.
